## Objective
- Redesign the entire Graffiti Merge game as a cohesive, high-quality pixel-art experience while preserving all gameplay and existing functionality.

## Requirements
- Pixel-art style must cover the whole game: characters, tools, environments, animations, UI, menus, icons, and effects.
- Replace modern green UI with retro pixel-art panels, frames, buttons, and inventory slots; avoid smooth vectors, gradients, blurry textures, and 3D styling.
- Use readable pixel typography with Russian/Cyrillic support throughout.
- Use a cohesive, warm, muted retro palette.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, drag-and-drop, artist behavior, or game logic.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing game and functionality; limit changes to visual presentation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing manual artist assignment, painting jobs, completion rewards, persistent murals, and responsive drag-and-drop were browser-tested before the redesign request.
- Fixed native image dragging interfering with pointer-based item drag-and-drop.

### Active
- Apply the requested full-game visual redesign.
- Verify all screens and responsive layouts retain existing functionality.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the existing UI, assets, fonts, and styles to plan a consistent pixel-art redesign.
2. Update visual assets and presentation across gameplay, menus, notifications, and responsive layouts without changing game logic.
3. Run syntax checks and browser-test drag-and-drop, artist jobs, menus, and the complete visual experience.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game rendering, interactions, artist jobs, and canvas scene.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI structure.
- `style.css`: Current UI styling and responsive layouts.
- `assets/pixel/`: Existing pixel-art environment, sprites, and tool assets.

## Important Context
- Earlier browser testing used `http://localhost:3002/`.
- Project changes were uncommitted; project files appeared as untracked.

## Objective
- Redesign Graffiti Merge as a cohesive, high-quality pixel-art game while preserving gameplay and existing functionality.
- Validate the visual redesign across screens and responsive layouts.

## Requirements
- Pixel-art styling for characters, tools, environments, animations, UI, menus, icons, and effects; avoid smooth vectors, gradients, blurry textures, and 3D styling.
- Readable pixel typography with Russian/Cyrillic support and a cohesive, warm, muted retro palette.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, drag-and-drop, artist behavior, or game logic.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing game and functionality; limit changes to visual presentation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `style.css` with a warm-toned pixel-inspired redesign, including responsive layouts and pixel-style panels, buttons, inventory slots, and notifications.
- Added bundled Pixelify Sans with Cyrillic support at `assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-cyrillic.ttf`.
- Confirmed `node --check game.js` passes and CSS braces are balanced.
- Browser-checked desktop rendering, upgrade dialog (4 groups, 5 rows), language switching, and a 390×844 mobile layout with no page overflow.

### Active
- Validate drag-and-drop, artist jobs, and upgrades/menu interactions; inspect responsive behavior at additional sizes and states.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test drag-and-drop, merging, and assigning tools to artists in the browser without changing game logic.
2. Check upgrade purchases/menu behavior and additional responsive sizes/orientations; fix any issues found.
3. Review the browser screenshots for remaining visual defects.

## Relevant Files
- `style.css`: Full visual redesign and responsive styling.
- `assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-cyrillic.ttf`: Bundled Pixelify Sans font.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI structure.
- `game.js`: Existing game rendering, interactions, and logic.
- `assets/pixel/`: Pixel-art environment, sprites, and tool assets.
- `screenshots/redesign.png`: Desktop browser capture.
- `screenshots/mobile.png`: Mobile browser capture.

## Important Context
- Browser testing used `http://localhost:3002/`; the page rendered with the game UI and canvas.
- Changes remain uncommitted; project files are untracked in the current Git status.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Redesign Graffiti Merge as a cohesive, high-quality pixel-art game while preserving gameplay and existing functionality.
- Validate the redesign across screens and responsive layouts.

## Requirements
- Use pixel-art styling for characters, tools, environments, animations, UI, menus, icons, and effects; avoid smooth vectors, gradients, blurry textures, and 3D styling.
- Use readable pixel typography with Russian/Cyrillic support and a cohesive, warm, muted retro palette.
- Do not change gameplay mechanics, drag-and-drop, artist behavior, or game logic.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing game and functionality; limit changes to visual presentation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `style.css` with a warm-toned pixel-inspired redesign, including responsive layouts and pixel-style panels, buttons, inventory slots, and notifications.
- Added bundled Pixelify Sans with Cyrillic support at `assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-cyrillic.ttf`.
- Confirmed `node --check game.js` passes and CSS braces are balanced.
- Browser-checked desktop rendering, upgrade dialog, language switching, and mobile portrait layout.
- Browser-tested merging matching tools, dragging a tool onto an artist, and purchasing an artist upgrade; saved game state and UI updated as expected.
- Checked layout overflow at 768×1024, 844×390, and 1280×600; none detected.
- Captured `screenshots/artist-assigned.png`, `screenshots/tablet-portrait.png`, and `screenshots/mobile-landscape.png`.

### Active
- Review responsive and interaction screenshots for any remaining visual defects.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the newer tablet and landscape screenshots, along with existing desktop/mobile captures, for visual issues.
2. Fix any presentation defects found without changing game logic.

## Relevant Files
- `style.css`: Pixel-art redesign and responsive styling.
- `assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-cyrillic.ttf`: Bundled Pixelify Sans font.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI structure.
- `game.js`: Existing game rendering, interactions, and logic.
- `assets/pixel/`: Environment, sprite, and tool assets.
- `screenshots/`: Desktop, mobile, tablet, landscape, and artist-assignment captures.

## Important Context
- Browser testing used `http://localhost:3002/`.
- Test interactions used a controlled save state; an artist was hired and a level-2 tool assigned to the first artist.
- Project changes are uncommitted; Git status showed project files as untracked.
